entities.name: Planes-hopping Era
entities.description: Fan nickname for the story period of the 2003-2008 blocks, each focused on a different plane with no overarching storyline.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane around which the game's narrative revolved until this era; revisited as a post-apocalyptic world in the Time Spiral block.

entities.name: Planeswalker Wars

entities.name: Alara Unbroken
entities.description: The storyline that returned to a saga format and began the Planeswalker Saga.

events.summary: The Time Spiral block returns to a post-apocalyptic Dominaria as an epilogue to the Planeswalker Wars.
events.quote: It also marked a return to a post-apocalyptic Dominaria in the Time Spiral block

events.summary: The storyline returns to a saga format with Alara Unbroken, beginning the Planeswalker Saga.
events.quote: the storyline itself returned to a saga format starting with Alara Unbroken
